correctness.rationale: Cone model follows by an invertible characteristic-two coordinate change; partial derivatives prove S smooth. Projection from vertex and the 27-line theorem classify reduced support, and \(H^0(\mathcal O(-1))=0\) yields generic reducedness of plane-dual components. A four-coefficient Grassmannian local restriction of cubic F yields base equation, linear form, quasilinear square, and cubic; independence and nonzero cubic coefficient give the geometric local ring \(k[u,v]/(u^2,v^3)\), length six. Exact F32 witness proves the genericity conditions are nonempty. Exhaustive F2/F4 line checks and Frobenius trace give exact finite-field counts and zeta function for all n. Nilpotents do not affect rational point counts. The proof explicitly limits completion to the geometric generic point, not global intersections.

This is best-knowledge originality, not a uniqueness certificate.

value.rationale: Infinitesimal deformations of lines are a canonical Hilbert/Fano invariant of cubic threefolds. A generically nonreduced length-six component with exact Artin algebra is structural information invisible in the classical reduced 27-line configuration or in the plane Fano scheme, and directly informs degeneration and deformation geometry. The object and invariant have a natural motivation independent of the finite-field enumeration; a precise generic scheme description across an entire component is not a routine renaming or tiny table extension.
